F1: Recreated strategies reuse the factory’s pool after shutdown, so submissions can be lost while their offsets are marked complete.
F2: Shutdown stops workers before they drain queued work and stops commits without ensuring final completions are committed.
F3: Unbounded queues can accumulate decoded work faster than workers process it and exhaust consumer memory.
F4: The test checks before the one-second commit cycle, masking that failed work is marked complete and can later be committed.
